about: What the Jahamun set is made from. The textures are CC0 photographs (Poly Haven), checked by SHA-1 (pipeline/textures.py); the references are only looked at, never put in the set (README.md, The references). Licences allowed in what the set embeds, as in the game's assets/src/textures/sources.json: CC0, MIT, CC BY 4.0.

polyhaven.about: Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com), textures all CC0 1.0 (https://polyhaven.com/license). Each map is fetched from https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/Textures/jpg/2k/<asset>/<file> and checked by its SHA-1.

long_white_tiles.what: long white glazed wall tiles, 4 x 9 cm, chipped and scuffed (1.27 m square): the walkway's wall, turned to run in rows

painted_concrete.what: green floor paint worn off concrete, scratched and cracked (2 m square): the walkway's red-brown anti-slip paint, recoloured, and the plaza's

plastered_wall_04.what: a grey plastered concrete wall (3.2 m square): the tunnel's painted lining above the tiles, and a neutral paint

asphalt_02.what: cracked road asphalt (3 m square): the carriageway

rock_wall_11.what: a wall of flat-faced polygonal stones with thin joints (1.91 m square): the retaining walls and the portal, graded grey

references.about: Looked at for the place's shape, size, colour and light; nothing of them is in the set.
references.video: the developer's own phone video of the walkway (private, not in the repository): 22 s, 720 x 1280, walking in and turning round

commons_parasite_location.what: by day: the red walkway outside the portal, the glass balustrade with its orange top rail, the polygonal stone retaining wall and its long stairs, the stone-faced arch

seoul_media_hub_2022.licence: Seoul Metropolitan Government, all rights reserved; a reference only
seoul_media_hub_2022.what: by night: the same place under warm street lamps, the LED strip under the balustrade's rail, the lane signals over the arch

ko_wikipedia.what: twin bores, each about 485 m, opened 30 August 1986; 7.7 m high, carriageway 16.8 m and walkways 3 m (both bores together)

namu_wiki.what: walkways made in both bores in 2010, the one toward Buam-dong behind a noise barrier (the glass)
